derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_multiple_xdefault`: more than one x-default on one page. Under A2 the unit is the `<link>` element and multiple_xdefault is not in A2's once-per-page exceptions, so each of the two x-default links on each page is one offending annotation (two per page, four in total); A and B return x-default to each other, list themselves and resolve canonical to self.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: multiple-xdefault-pair
